features: 【Solar Panel = Portable Charger】This tech backpack is designed for college students and business users. It has a USB charging port and an integrated solar panel, allowing charging without a portable power bank. Featuring a monocrystalline silicon solar panel, it offers good conversion efficiency and a long service life of 25–30 years. (Note: Requires UV intensity, no energy storage)However, it can be charged by connecting to a power bank via the built-in USB data cable

【Waterproof & Shock-Resistant】Crafted from 1680D polyester and ABS materials,solar backpack’s solar panel TSA-friendly is exceptionally sturdy and durable.This laptop travel backpack features a sturdy built-in strap that securely attaches to suitcase telescopic handles. The backpack has a breathable honeycomb back pad for even pressure distribution.This waterproof backpack features reinforced fabric that protects your electronics, clothing and other essentials from sudden rain

【Charge Multiple Devices Simultaneously】This tech backpack men also features a solar panel (with 5V/2A output and dual AC port design), paired with external USB ports for flexible charging: connect the internal cable to the junction box first, then plug your devices into the external USB ports for solar charging. You can also connect devices directly to the built-in junction box for power, or use both methods at the same time. A practical solution for powering low-power devices

【TSA Lock Travel Backpack, Airline Approved】This backpack with laptop compartment also features a resettable TSA-friendly lock to secure your valuables and privacy, this tech backpack with luggage strap attaches securely to luggage for easier carrying, while its 13x8x18-inch size complies with airline carry-on standards and fits in overhead bins or under seats, making it a good travel companion

【Multi-Functional, Large-Capacity & Good Travel Gift】This solar backpack with solar panel features two separate laptop compartments and multiple pockets, easily accommodating all your daily essentials. Designed with a sleek, gender-neutral style, it is suitable for both men and women – and makes ideal travel gifts for women or men and loved ones for birthdays, travel, holidays and other special occasions. It’s a practical and stylish backpack ideal for daily use and travel

With power and distinct performance of an AI-dedicated processor, this gram Pro efficiently handles AI and machine learning tasks.

Unbelievably Portable. Undeniably Strong. - The LG gram Pro laptop packs incredible performance into a half-inch-thin, 2.7 lbs. frame that’s passed seven military-grade standards for resilience and durability. From your desk to the road, gram Pro is built to go wherever you work and play.
